title: jsc2019m000710_Designing-Flames-Aboard-ISS-MP4
description: The Flame Design investigation is studying the quantity of soot produced under different flame conditions. The results of this experiment occurring aboard the International Space Station could enable the design of flames that are more sooty or soot-free, and allow for the creation of burner designs which are more efficient and less polluting. Read more about this and other flame research aboard the International Space Station: https://go.nasa.gov/2LqSzja   Learn more about the research being conducted on Station: https://www.nasa.gov/iss-science    Follow Twitter updates on the science conducted aboard the space station:  https://twitter.com/iss_research

title: Hot Flame Aboard the International Space Station
description: The hot flame created during a test for the Cool Flames Investigation with Gases experiment is shown burning. After the flame appears to extinguish, a cool flame is created. While too faint to be visible in real time during space station testing, the research team uncovered the presence of cool flames in the data.  Learn more: https://go.nasa.gov/3AJmhc4
